text: Consultation externe: Patiente de 31 ans consulte pour céphalées hémicrâniennes gauches pulsatiles depuis 2 ans, crises durant 12 à 24 heures avec nausées et photophobie, sans aura visuelle ni déficit neurologique. Examen neurologique normal. Diagnostic: Migraine sans aura. Plan: Sumatriptan 50mg si crise, repos dans le noir.

Mgonjwa: Mtoto wa miaka 4 analetwa na mama yake kwa ajili ya kuwashwa sana ngozi hasa usiku, katikati ya vidole vya mikono na vifundo vya mikono. Kaka yake ana upele kama huo. O/E: Papules na burrows interdigital web spaces bilat, wrists. Dx: Classical scabies (upele waสะเก็ด/ukurutu wa funza). Plan: Permethrin 5% cream mwili mzima usiku, fua nguo kwa maji ya moto.

Paciente masculino de 29 años procedente de zona endémica con fiebre alta de 4 días de evolución, cefalea retroocular intensa, mialgias y artralgias, exantema maculopapular. Sin dolor abdominal intenso, sin vómitos persistentes, sin sangrado mucoso. Plaquetas 118,000, Hto estable. Prueba NS1 positiva. Diagnóstico: Dengue sin signos de alarma. Plan: Hidratación oral, paracetamol, evitar AINEs.

48F referred from breast clinic with 2.5cm painless hard irregular lump R upper outer quadrant x3/12. Core needle biopsy histology report today: Invasive ductal carcinoma of breast, ER+, PR+, HER2 negative. Staging CT awaited. Imp: Invasive ductal carcinoma of right breast. Plan: MDT review for neoadjuvant vs primary surgery.

39F G4P4, post-coital bleeding and offensive watery vaginal discharge x4/12. Speculum: friable exophytic cervical lesion. Cervical punch biopsy histology: Squamous cell carcinoma of cervix uteri. Imp: Squamous cell carcinoma of cervix. Plan: Urgent gynae-oncology referral for FIGO staging.

Doctor: How have you been feeling over the past month?
Patient: Honestly doctor, since I lost my job six weeks ago, I feel empty every single day. I have no energy, I wake up at 4am and cannot sleep again, and I have lost interest in everything. Never felt like this before in my life.
Doctor: Any thoughts of harming yourself, or hearing voices?
Patient: No voices, and I wouldn't hurt myself, I just feel hopeless and struggle to concentrate at home.
Doctor: This is a first episode of moderate depression, without any psychotic features. We will start fluoxetine 20mg each morning and arrange weekly counselling.

3yo boy, fever + pulling at R ear + crying at night x2/7 after a cold. Otoscopy: bulging erythematous R tympanic membrane with loss of light reflex, no perforation, no mastoid tenderness. Dx: Acute otitis media R ear. Amoxicillin 40mg/kg/d BD x5/7, paracetamol.

72M retired farmer, gradual painless bilateral loss of vision over 3 years, glare with oncoming headlights at night. VA R 6/36, L 6/24. Slit lamp: dense mature nuclear and cortical lens opacities bilaterally, normal IOP, red reflex dulled. Imp: Age-related cataract, bilateral (mature R). Plan: Book R cataract extraction + IOL implant.

56F slipped on wet tiles and fell onto outstretched R hand (FOOSH) 2 hrs ago. Painful deformed R wrist. Neurovascularly intact distally. XR R wrist: distal radius fracture with dorsal angulation/tilt (Colles pattern), extra-articular. Imp: Fracture of lower end of radius, dorsal tilt. Plan: Hematoma block, closed reduction and below-elbow backslab, check XR.

19M student, 24h hx periumbilical pain migrating to R iliac fossa, anorexia, nausea, single vomit. T 37.9, PR 96. Tender McBurney's point with localised guarding and rebound in RIF, Rovsing sign +, abdomen soft elsewhere (no generalised peritonism). WBC 14.8. US: non-compressible 9mm appendix, trace periappendiceal fluid, no perforation. Imp: Acute appendicitis with localised peritonitis. Plan: IV fluids, cefuroxime + metronidazole, urgent laparoscopic appendicectomy.

61M smoker, crushing central chest pain radiating to L arm and jaw x90 min, diaphoretic. BP 142/88, PR 94, SpO2 97%. 12-lead ECG: 4mm ST segment elevation in leads V1-V4 with reciprocal ST depression II, III, aVF. Troponin I positive. Imp: Acute ST elevation myocardial infarction (anterior STEMI). Plan: Loading aspirin 300mg + clopidogrel 600mg, heparin, immediate transfer for primary PCI.

26F c/o fatigue, pica (craving soil), heavy menstrual bleeding x8/12. Pale conjunctivae, koilonychia. Hb 8.4 g/dL, MCV 66 fL, ferritin 6 ng/mL. Not pregnant. Dx: Acquired iron deficiency anaemia due to chronic blood loss (menorrhagia). Ferrous sulphate 200mg TDS x3/12, tranexamic acid during menses.

Urgences: Homme de 35 ans, diarrhée aqueuse profuse aspect 'eau de riz' depuis ce matin (>15 selles), vomissements, crampes musculaires, retour d'une zone d'épidémie. Pli cutané persistant, TA 85/50, pouls filant. Coproculture rapide: Vibrio cholerae O1 positif. Diagnostic: Choléra. Plan: Réhydratation IV Ringer Lactate immédiate + Doxycycline 300mg dose unique.

34F accountant, difficulty falling asleep and staying asleep 4-5 nights/wk for the past 6 months, daytime fatigue and irritability. Sleep hygiene poor, no sleep apnoea, no depression or anxiety disorder, no substance use. Imp: Chronic insomnia. Plan: CBT-I sleep restriction and stimulus control protocol.

5-day-old term male neonate, exclusively breastfed, thriving, brought for yellow discolouration of face and chest noted day 3. Alert, good suck, normal tone, stool/urine normal colour. Mother O+, baby O+, DCT negative. Total serum bilirubin 215 umol/L (unconjugated), below phototherapy threshold. Imp: Neonatal hyperbilirubinaemia, physiological / unspecified. Plan: Continue frequent breastfeeding, repeat TSB in 24h.

Consulta de oftalmología: Mujer de 64 años asintomática en control rutinario. Agudeza visual 20/20 AO. Tonometría: PIO 28 mmHg OD, 26 mmHg OI. Gonioscopia: ángulo abierto bilateral. Fondo de ojo: excavación papilar 0.7 con adelgazamiento del anillo neuroretiniano, defecto arqueado en campimetría. Diagnóstico: Glaucoma primario de ángulo abierto con presión elevada. Plan: Latanoprost colirio 1 gota nocturna AO.

21M university student brought by family with 7-month history of auditory hallucinations (two voices commenting on his actions), delusions of persecution that neighbours are transmitting thoughts via radio, social withdrawal and flat affect. No substance abuse, HIV negative, normal brain MRI. First presentation, currently floridly symptomatic. Imp: Schizophrenia, first episode, currently symptomatic. Plan: Risperidone 2mg nocte, psychoeducation, psychiatric follow-up.

67M hypertensive, sudden-onset R hemiparesis and expressive aphasia 3 hours ago. BP 164/92, pulse 78 regular (sinus rhythm on ECG). Non-contrast CT brain: no haemorrhage, early MCA territory hypodensity. Carotid Doppler: 80% ulcerated atherosclerotic plaque L internal carotid artery. Imp: Cerebral ischaemic stroke due to extracranial large artery atherosclerosis. Plan: Thrombolysis / stroke unit admission, aspirin + high-dose statin after 24h CT.

16F mwanafunzi, history of recurrent unprovoked generalised tonic-clonic seizures (degedege / kifafa) x3 episodes in 4 months, tongue biting and post-ictal drowsiness x30 min. No fever, no trauma, perinatal hx normal, MRI brain normal. EEG: generalised spike-and-wave discharges. Imp: Idiopathic generalised epilepsy / epilepsy unspecified. Plan: Sodium valproate (counselled on teratogenicity) or Levetiracetam 500mg BD.

44M construction worker, acute low back pain x4/7 after lifting heavy cement bag. Pain localised to lumbar paraspinal muscles, worse on bending, no radiation to legs, no numbness, no bladder/bowel symptoms, no fever or wt loss. Straight leg raise negative bilat, power 5/5, reflexes intact. Imp: Low back pain, mechanical / unspecified. Plan: Ibuprofen 400mg TDS x5/7, stay active, physiotherapy.
